decision.interpretation: The 55-local/5-global candidate is source-complete and physically material, but predicts only an incremental single-digit whole-request gain. It is a quality-unsafe candidate for a cheap execution proxy, not a campaign terminal or production claim.

prefill.evidence_type: measured_scope_matched_c32_h200_attention subtype time plus measured aggregate FP8-linear time apportioned by exact projection FLOPs

limitations: The whole-request range propagates two counter-derived target-pass counts; it is a scenario range, not a statistical confidence interval.
The target-verification attention and projection inputs are exact c32 H200 measurements, but the M8 endpoint consumer produced no durable pair.
The prefill attention subtype input is a scope-matched v0.5.13 c32 H200 profile at 0.7051819141250064 s/request, not the locked qualified denominator.
Prefill FP8-linear time is measured only in aggregate and apportioned to layer geometry by exact projection FLOPs; persistent-kernel latency need not scale perfectly with FLOPs.
No batching benefit is credited, no GPU was claimed, and no model-quality evidence was produced.

physical_prediction.interpretation: Each conversion replaces a 512-wide, 4-KV-head full-prefix kernel with a 256-wide, 16-KV-head 1,024-window kernel. Measured M8 resources move from 255 to 173 registers/thread and 102.4 to 37.888 KiB dynamic shared memory; grid waves double while DRAM and L2 bytes fall. The c32 KV footprint falls, but prior c48/c64 negatives make a batching gain unsupported.

availability.access_model: major and specialist clouds, usually HGX nodes

co_design_notes: Same Hopper compute architecture with much larger/faster memory
Strong for memory-bound decode and large single-GPU residency

selected_candidate.cheapest_later_execution_proxy: Materialize a quality-unsafe five-module nearest-local weight-copy checkpoint, run one exact c32 M384 target-forward component comparing 50/10 and 55/5 on H200, then run an endpoint pair only if component timing and output finiteness pass.
selected_candidate.falsifier: Reject the physical model if a converted layer does not dispatch the measured local M8 geometry or if the c32 target-forward cycle improves by less than 12.053363 ms minus contemporaneous noise; reject the candidate if recovery misses the exact GPQA-Diamond, TauBench, long-context, or tool-use gates.
selected_candidate.name: half_global_keep_early_in_each_pair
quality_recovery_path: Initialize only the five converted attention modules from their nearest same-shape sliding-attention neighbors; retain each layer's MLP and norms.
Distill hidden states, attention outputs, and logits from the locked 50/10 teacher on 4K-to-32K text plus long-context retrieval and tool-use trajectories.
Continue pretraining with a curriculum that preserves 1,024-token local behavior before increasing long-context examples.
Require exact served-model GPQA-Diamond and TauBench gates, long-context retrieval, tool-call formatting, and multimodal regression before production eligibility.

semantics.reason: Changing a full-attention layer to sliding attention changes head dimension 512 to 256, KV heads 4 to 16, RoPE, receptive field, projection shapes, parameters, and checkpoint tensor compatibility.
